metric.description: Macro-average of three constrained Top-10 AUCs; higher is better. At each property-evaluation checkpoint q=0..16, the best ten observed utilities are zero-padded to denominator 10. Each task's trapezoidal area over the 16 intervals is divided by the fixed perfect-sequence area 0.6875, rounded half-even to 12 decimals, and the macro mean is rounded half-even to 8 decimals. Candidate utility is a weighted geometric mean of five clipped desirabilities and is zero after any route or hard-constraint failure. The theoretical raw bounds are 0 and 1. The linear display transform maps raw 0 to 0 and raw 1 to 1000 without capping; invalid submissions are not ranked and carry the -100 display sentinel.
